nodes.description: Address of the contract owner stored in state (Owned.owner).
Last block number recorded during Play; used by protect_mining anti-miner check.
Constant magic = 5 used for max bet divisor and modulo payout condition.
Constructor of Owned that sets owner = msg.sender.
Modifier restricting execution to msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner function that destroys the contract and sends funds to msg.sender.
Irreversible selfdestruct call transferring the whole balance.
Public view returning getBalance()/magic, the maximum allowed bet.
Payable game entry point guarded by protect and protect_mining; pays out on now % magic != 0 and records block.number.
Modifier requiring block.number != last_blocknumber as weak miner protection.
Payable fallback function that forwards to Play().
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, origin check, and ether transfers.
Transaction origin used by the protect modifier for the tx.origin == msg.sender check.
now / block.timestamp used to decide whether the player wins (now % magic != 0).
External ether transfer msg.sender.transfer(msg.value + msg.value/magic) executed before state update.

edges.reason: Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
msg.sender is read to initialize owner during construction.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner to gate privileged functions.
close() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
close() executes selfdestruct(msg.sender) after the onlyOwner check.
selfdestruct forwards the contract balance to msg.sender.
Play reads msg.sender and msg.value as the player and wager.
Play calls getMaxBet() to validate the bet size.
getMaxBet calls getBalance() to read the contract balance.
getMaxBet divides the balance by the magic constant.
Play branches on now (block.timestamp) modulo magic, creating timestamp/outcome dependency.
Play uses the magic constant in the now % magic payout condition.
Play performs an external ether transfer before writing last_blocknumber, violating checks-effects-interactions.
transfer sends ether to the untrusted msg.sender via an external call before state is updated.
Play writes block.number into last_blocknumber after the payout transfer.
protect_mining reads last_blocknumber for the anti-miner comparison.
Play is guarded by the protect_mining modifier.
protect compares the untrusted tx.origin with msg.sender.
protect compares tx.origin with the untrusted msg.sender.
Play is guarded by the protect modifier enforcing tx.origin == msg.sender.
The payable fallback function invokes Play().
